picks.name: Jay Mitta
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Nyege Nyege Tapes. Similar high-BPM, club-adjacent territory to your N.A.A.F.I and footwork picks.
picks.bio: A singeli originator from Dar Es Salaam, Tanzania, made at Sisso Studios where the genre was born. "Kazi Kwanza" (September 4, 2026) is his first album in seven years -- 13 fully instrumental tracks pushing singeli's breakneck 180+ BPM rhythms through trap, trance, grime, drill and hard techno.
picks.why_listen: Relentless, breakneck-tempo material that's genuinely unlike anything else in your library -- a jolt of energy for a peak-time curveball or a hard transition.

picks.name: N.A.A.F.I
picks.bio: "PIRATA 7" (September 4, 2026) is the latest in N.A.A.F.I's long-running Pirata mixtape series -- 23 tracks of edits, bootlegs and mashups splicing reggaeton, pop, drum & bass, and club staples into one continuous DJ-ready blast.
picks.why_listen: A ready-made bag of party-starting edits and mashups from a label you already trust for boundary-pushing club music -- useful as a grab-bag of transitions and curveballs.
